text: うえに　いる　なかまも　あくりょうに　おそわれた　ようだ！

structure.jp: うえに　いる　なかまも
structure.en: my companions who are upstairs too

structure.jp: あくりょうに　おそわれた

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.span: あくりょうに　おそわれた
patterns.explanation: おそわれる is おそう turned around: the attack is done to someone, and に shows who did it. あくりょうに おそわれた = 'were attacked by evil spirits'.

patterns.name: 〜ようだ
patterns.span: おそわれた　ようだ
patterns.explanation: ようだ after a statement means 'it looks like', a guess from what you can see. おそわれた ようだ = 'it seems they were attacked'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: うえに　いる　なかま
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase put right before a noun describes that noun. うえに いる なかま = 'the companions who are upstairs'.
